name: Goa
description: Sun-drenched coastal haven renowned for golden sand crescent beaches, Portuguese colonial heritage, spice plantations, and vibrant nightlife.

name: Jaipur
description: The historic Pink City, home to majestic Rajput forts, ornate amber palaces, bustling craft bazaars, and royal culinary legacies.

name: Manali
description: Enchanting mountain resort nestled in the Pir Panjal range with alpine cedar forests, gushing rivers, snow-covered mountain passes, and adventure trails.

name: Kerala
description: Tropical paradise of tranquil palm-fringed backwaters, emerald high-altitude tea plantations, serene Ayurvedic sanctuaries, and spice-laden coastlines.

name: Bengaluru / Coorg
description: Known as the Scotland of India, an undulating expanse of misty coffee and cardamom plantations, thundering waterfalls, and ancient Kodava traditions.

name: Udaipur
description: Romantic City of Lakes centered around tranquil Lake Pichola, floating white marble palaces, regal courtyard havelis, and Aravalli mountain panoramas.

name: Madurai
description: One of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, crowned by the breathtaking sculpted gopurams of Meenakshi Amman Temple and storied Tamil literature.

name: Assam Tea Country
description: Lush northeastern realm of sprawling heritage colonial tea estates, the mighty Brahmaputra river, and Kaziranga National Park home to the one-horned rhinoceros.

name: Leh-Ladakh
description: Dramatic high-altitude desert featuring azure glacial lakes like Pangong Tso, centuries-old Buddhist gompas perched on cliffs, and world's highest motorable passes.

name: Varanasi
description: Spiritual epicenter of India with mystical sunrise boat rides on the sacred Ganga, evocative evening Aarti ceremonies, labyrinthine alleys, and sacred silk weavers.
